texts: More than 900 pages are live, and Atlas at three.ws/atlas puts all of them in one searchable place, grouped into 10 sections. Type what you want to do instead of a page name. Searching "animation" returns more than 20 matching pages, and a goal card beside them lays out the steps in order.
Fifteen goals cover the common starts: make a 3D avatar, put one on your website, create an AI agent, animate or pose it, make it talk. Each names the pages to open, in order.
